thread:
Sam: paging — elevated 5xx + timeouts from NimbusPay on Dedicated cluster c-ldn-2, started ~11:03 UTC. Customer reporting aborted payments. Stack shows gateway 502 and ML-serving timeouts.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2149 — ded-cluster capacity / noisy-tenant. Paging on-call.

Priya: I'm on it — taking lead. @Sam can you drop the customer impact numbers you have?

Sam: Quick snapshot: 11:03–11:10 UTC — 18% 5xx rate on their route, p95 latency <-> 6s, many 504s from proxy. Traffic mostly medium payload chat completions. No config changes from customer.

Jorge: Looking at infra, c-ldn-2 GPU utilization at 98% on pool-a, memory pressure shows OOM kills on a few pods. I see one tenant (tenant-nimbus) with burst of connections and huge sequence lengths — KV cache thrash.

Marta: Can we identify if it's noisy neighbor vs model degeneracy? Any specific model pinned?

Sam: They pinned gpt-small-8k-quant. Kernel logs show frequent recompile warnings + heavy attention kernels.

Priya: Ok plan: 1) quick mitigation: apply tenant-level QPS throttle and reduce concurrency to 2 for NimbusPay route; 2) route a small percentage (5–10%) of their traffic to fallback variant (gpt-small-4k-quant) with lower mem; 3) trigger reserve burst scale if autoscale fails.

Evan: I'll push the rate-limit rule now and add a temporary per-tenant concurrency cap. Command: `rdctl routing update --tenant=nimbus --qps=120 --concurrency=2`

Riley: Throttle applied. Monitoring now. Error rate dipped to 12% after ~90s. p95 still high.

Jorge: Adding routing fallback: `rdctl route promote --from=cluster:c-ldn-2/model:gpt-small-8k-quant --to=model:gpt-small-4k-quant --percent=8 --tenant=nimbus`

Marta: Fallback routed. Observing downstream: 5xx trend flattening to 8% over next 3 minutes. Some tail latencies still high for in-flight requests.

Sam: Customer on the call — they confirm some reduced failures but still seeing timeouts on larger payloads. Asking for ETA.

Priya: We're seeing kernel OOMs due to KV growth. Jorge, can you evict large KV entries for that tenant and bump cache eviction aggressiveness?

Jorge: Doing targeted eviction for tenant-nimbus KV prefixes. Command: `infctl kv evict --tenant=nimbus --prefix=session:`. Also toggling cache-policy to lru-aggressive for that pool.

incident-bot: Action logged: kv-evict by Jorge @ 11:14 UTC.

Jorge: Eviction applied. Memory pressure relieved on 3/4 nodes, GPU util down to ~85%. 5xx at 4% and p95 latency trending down to 1.2s.

Marta: Good. We should also consider longer-term: recommend customer shorten max sequence length or move large-batch jobs off Dedicated to a batch endpoint. I'll draft customer-facing mitigation steps.

Priya: On-call handoff to Riley in 30m for monitoring/verify. Riley, take lead for post-incident follow-ups and customer comms.

Riley: Taking handoff. Will keep watch for 1 hour, collecting logs and token-level cost impact. Noting impacted window 11:03–11:20 UTC. Estimating 22k failed tokens, 1.4% of their daily requests.

Sam: Ops note: We temporarily reduced NimbusPay throughput — they may see increased latency for spikes. We informed them in call and set rollback triggers.

Evan: Autoscale check: cluster failed to spin an extra reserved node because quota for reserved GPU burst was at 0. I raised a ticket to enable emergency-burst with infra team. For now we rely on throttles & fallback.

Marta: Postmortem items: noisy-tenant detection heuristic needs improvement (detect extreme kv growth), allow emergency burst even if reserved quota exhausted, tenant-level auto-eviction policy, and better routing fallback automation.

Riley: Customer follow-up draft: short summary of incident, immediate mitigations we applied, recommended config changes (max_seq, concurrency), and offer a reserved burst top-up. I'll post for review.

Priya: Closing notes: incident declared resolved at 11:20 UTC — error rates returned to baseline ~<1%. Keeping follow-up tasks in INC-2026-2149. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-2149 marked RESOLVED by Priya @ 11:20 UTC.

Riley: Handoff complete. Will create postmortem doc and include heap/kernels trace.

Sam: Thanks — good fast mitigation.
